steps: Open WeatherPanel example in Arduino IDE
Configure board settings as specified above
Select COM port (appears when board is connected)
Wait for compilation and upload (may take 2-5 minutes)
Open Serial Monitor (115200 baud) to view output
troubleshooting: If upload fails: Press BOOT button and press RESET button
If screen doesn't turn on: Check version (V1/V2) and pin configuration
If WiFi fails: Verify SSID/password and signal strength

steps: Open terminal in VS Code with ESP-IDF extension
Run 'idf.py flash monitor' or 'idf.py flash' then open monitor
Press ENTER to start the application
troubleshooting: If build fails: Check sdkconfig and component dependencies
If flash fails: Verify board is in download mode (BOOT held + RESET)
If monitor doesn't show output: Check COM port and baud rate

important_considerations: WeatherPanel integration with ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.49 requires careful version matching (V1/V2)
LVGL 8.3.0 is critical - newer versions may break forced software rotation
API rate limits should be considered for production deployments
Consider offline fallback for critical weather displays
Power consumption is significant - plan for appropriate power supply
PSRAM is essential for displaying images alongside LVGL UI
